question: What do the words Jesus cried out, "Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?" mean?
options: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?
Into your hands I commit my spirit
explanation: At three in the afternoon Jesus cried out, "Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?" (which means "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?").
